subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing - GPU type & TPS targets
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>, Tom Nguyen <tn@acme.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing - recap & next steps

Hi Jane / Tom \u2014

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can size Dedicated capacity correctly: 

Recap:
- Deployment mode: you indicated a preference for Dedicated capacity (VPC peering) versus Hosted API \u2014 primary drivers are predictable throughput and data isolation.
- Primary workloads: chat + instruction generation for product search assistant, occasional embeddings for reranking.
- Models discussed: Mistral-instruct / Llama-2 family as possibilities; we'll confirm model choice on the next call.

Sizing inputs we need (please fill the attached capacity-scenarios.csv if helpful):
- Peak TPS (requests/s) and sustained TPS
- Concurrent sessions/users (average and heavy concurrency)
- Token mix: average prompt tokens vs completion tokens, and any long-context tails
- Percent of requests that are embeddings vs generation
- Target P95/P99 latency SLOs (if you have them)
- Any strict compliance/network constraints (IPs for VPC peering, egress rules)

Quick notes on GPU choice: we typically offer H100-backed Dedicated for the highest performance (lower latency / better throughput for large models) and A100 / A10G options for cost-optimized runs. Exact recommendation depends on model (FP16 vs quantized), avg sequence length, and desired latency SLOs.

Proposed next steps:
1) Please fill the attached capacity-scenarios.csv with the numbers above (or reply inline).
2) Schedule a 30\u201345m architecture sync with one of our infra engineers (I can bring Connor).
3) We'll provide two sizing options (performance vs cost-optimized) and a draft quote (PDF).

I've attached a blank capacity-scenarios.csv for convenience. If you prefer, send a sample of real traffic (anonymized) and we can run a quick run-rate estimate.

Thanks \u2014
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments: capacity-scenarios.csv

Hi Aditya \u2014

Thanks for the writeup. I filled out the attached CSV (attached) with two scenarios (nominal and peak). High-level numbers below: 

- Peak TPS: 40 req/s (short spikes up to ~55 for marketing events)
- Sustained TPS: 12\u201318 req/s
- Concurrent sessions: ~250 active sessions during peak (many short-lived)
- Token mix (avg): prompt 120 tokens, completion 450 tokens (we often ask for longer completions for summaries)
- Embeddings: ~5% of requests for reranking; batch embeddings offline for most use cases
- Target latency: P95 < 800ms for short prompts, happy to accept higher tail for long completions
- Models: leaning toward Mistral-instruct (cost + quality) but we may test Llama-2-13B for a high-quality path

We do prefer Dedicated with VPC peering. I've attached the filled capacity-scenarios.csv. Also note we require SOC2 attestation and a short vendor questionnaire (we'll send to your security contact).

Happy to do the architecture sync next week \u2014 Tom will coordinate a time.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity sizing - GPU type & TPS targets

Jane \u2014 great, thanks for the numbers and the filled CSV. Based on the inputs you provided we can propose two reasonable Dedicated configurations for initial sizing (we'll refine after the architecture call and any test runs):

Option A \u2014 Performance (recommended if low latency and high model headroom matter):
- Hardware: 4x H100 GPUs (IPC-optimized cluster)
- Rationale: H100 gives best throughput for Mistral/Llama inference at FP16/AMP; supports larger batch sizes and lower P95 tail for mixed-length workloads.
- Expected throughput: comfortably handle sustained 15\u201320 TPS with room for 40 TPS peaks (with autoscaling/burst configured).
- Concurrency: supports your ~250 concurrent short sessions with prefix/KV caching; we recommend session affinity for chat workloads.

Option B \u2014 Cost-optimized (if model size limited to 13B / quantized):
- Hardware: 8x A100 / A10G nodes with aggressive quantization (4-bit where acceptable)
- Rationale: lower hourly cost; more instances to absorb variable loads. Good for Llama-2-13B or quantized Mistral variants.
- Expected throughput: targets sustained 12\u201318 TPS and can be tuned for 40 TPS peaks with slightly higher latencies for long completions.

Operational notes / next steps:
- We'll prepare a draft quote (attached redwood-dedicated-quote.pdf) showing both options and approximate lead times.
- For VPC peering we'll need your baseline CIDR ranges and a list of egress IPs \u2014 I can send a template before the architecture call.
- Connor (cc'd) will join the architecture sync to discuss autoscaling, batching/quantization tradeoffs, and network setup.
- SOC2 / security: I'll route the questionnaire to our security team and share SOC2 link in the next email.

Would you be available for a 45m sync on Tue 2026-05-07 or Wed 2026-05-08?

Best,
Aditya
